query: /* postgres */ update t_user set username = $1, email = $2, password = $3, display_name = $4, avatar_url = $5, role = $6, is_active = $7, github_id = $8, keycloak_id = $9, created_at = $10, updated_at = $11, must_change_password = $12, mfa_enabled = $13, totp_secret = $14, mfa_backup_codes = $15, totp_last_step = $16 where id = $17
